outcome: Give head of quality / clinical operations director a governed method to improve sites reaching screened-enrolment targets using de-identified patient cohorts, site capacity and protocol criteria…
overview: Clinical Trial Site Recruitment Feasibility addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in pharma and life sciences operations. The first proof of value uses de-identified patient cohorts, site capacity and protocol criteria. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is sites reaching screened-enrolment targets, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

benefits.limits: Basis: design hypothesis. Depends on source quality and named decision owner

benefits.limits: Basis: customer-specific hypothesis. No uplift promised; validate in controlled pilot

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: de-identified patient cohorts, site capacity and protocol criteria; define sites reaching screened-enrolment targets and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of Quality / Clinical Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for sites reaching screened-enrolment targets
